paragraphs: Rabbi Avdumi bar Tanchum: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Moed Katan.
Rabbi Mana bar Tanchum: Jerusalem Talmud Terumot, chapter 5, halakhah 2.
Rabbi Shmuel bar Tanchum: Bereshit Rabbah, beginning of chapter 66.[^1]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer passages fully name Rabbi Avdumi bar Tanchum at Moed Katan 3:8 and Rabbi Mana bar Tanchum at Terumot 5:2. The Torat Emet digital Bereshit Rabbah 66:2 fully names Rabbi Shmuel bar Tanchum; Hyman’s “beginning of chapter 66” is retained.
